prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for a milk thistle liver-support tincture. Flat-lay top-down view of a small amber glass dropper bottle (warm honey-amber tint, soft highlights) lying slightly off-center (lower left) on a bone #F7EFE2 surface, with a black rubber dropper bulb and a tiny cream kraft label that reads simply 'Milk Thistle' in clean serif type. Scattered around: a small pile of milk thistle seeds (mottled brown-tan ovals) and one milk thistle flower head (spiky purple-pink crown over a green spiny base). The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no extra text, no liquid spills.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Glass bottle has gentle highlights, NOT painterly glints. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. Cool diffuse morning light from upper left casts a faint shadow below the bottle. Feels detoxifying, restorative, plant-medicine. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
